hints.title: Maximizing Strategy
hints.text: To maximize the integer, replace the first digit from the left that is not 9 with 9.

hints.title: Minimizing Strategy
hints.text: To minimize the integer, if the first digit is not 1, replace all occurrences of it with 1. If it is 1, replace the first subsequent digit not 0 or 1 with 0.

hints.title: Compute Difference
hints.text: Convert both modified string numbers back to integers and return max_val - min_val.

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute forcing all digit replacement pairs is possible but unnecessary when greedy selection is deterministic.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Inspecting digits from most significant position takes constant O(1) time since L <= 9.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles edge cases for minimization without introducing leading zeros.
complexity.notes: No leading zeros allowed in either number.
